verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document Raygun's event-ingestion API or payload format, so it shows no way for custom clients to send events without an official SDK. The only related item is a 2013 community comment that the .NET providers are open source and could be extended with a NancyFX provider. That is an adjacent developer building block built on official SDK code, not a documented open protocol. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, the event-ingestion protocol is documented and open enough that custom clients and compatible SDKs can send events without an official SDK
